name: Church Leadership
overview: Scripture teaches that church leadership is a sacred responsibility entrusted by the Holy Spirit to oversee and care for God's people, as seen in Acts 20:28 where leaders are called to feed the church purchased by Christ's blood. True greatness in leadership is marked by humility and service, valuing others above oneself (Philippians 2:3; Matthew 20:26). Leaders are to guard their hearts diligently (Proverbs 4:23), persevere in well-doing (Galatians 6:9), and serve as faithful examples whose lives and teachings guide the congregation (Hebrews 13:7).
